emails.accountBlocked.appeal: If you believe this is a mistake, you can request a review of this decision by contacting the organisation responsible for the service through its usual citizen support channels.
emails.accountBlocked.body: We have restricted access to your account for breaching the community rules of the incident-reporting service. From now on you will not be able to sign in or post content.
emails.accountBlocked.dataRetention: Any incidents you reported are kept so that the municipal services can process them.
emails.accountBlocked.heading: Your account has been restricted
emails.accountBlocked.subject: PID Gijón - Your account has been restricted
emails.accountBlocked.title: Account restricted
emails.accountUnblocked.body: The restriction on your account has been lifted. You can sign in again and report incidents as usual.
emails.accountUnblocked.heading: Your account has been restored
emails.accountUnblocked.rules: Please remember that the community rules of the service still apply: further breaches may lead to a new restriction.
emails.accountUnblocked.subject: PID Gijón - Your account has been restored
emails.accountUnblocked.title: Account restored
